import { h, replace } from "/src/ui/dom.ts";
import { itemIcon, itemName } from "/src/ui/items.ts";
import { startingKits } from "/src/ui/starting-kits.ts";
/** Existing prepared copies only; permanent unlocks remain in Forge. */
export function renderBloodlineLoadouts(app) {
	const L = app.lineage;
	const owner = app.engine;
	const slot = L.selected_bloodline;
	const picks = L.supplies ?? [];
	const cap = L.supply_cap;
	const away = !!L.live || L.town?.home === false;
	const full = cap === undefined || picks.length >= cap;
	const feedback = h("div", {
		role: "status",
		class: "loadout-feedback"
	});
	const catalogue = h("div", { class: "bloodline-catalogue" });
	const current = () => catalogue.isConnected && app.engine === owner && app.lineage.selected_bloodline === slot;
	const authored = L.starting_kits?.current;
	const paint = (rows) => {
		if (!current()) return;
		replace(catalogue, ...rows.map((e) => h("button", {
			class: "btn bloodline-prepare",
			"data-prepare-kind": e.kind,
			disabled: away || full || !!e.needs || e.price !== 0,
			title: away ? "Hero away — change the next kit at home" : full ? cap === undefined ? "Slot information unavailable" : /* copy:tooltip */ "Prepared slots full" : e.needs || "Free unlocked preparation",
			onclick: () => {
				if (!current() || app.lineage.live || app.lineage.town?.home === false) return;
				void app.mutate(
					() => authored && owner.setStartingKit ? owner.setStartingKit(JSON.stringify({
						...authored,
						supplies: [...authored.supplies, e.kind]
					})) : owner.buySupply(e.kind),
					/* copy:callout */
					"Prepared"
				);
			}
		}, itemIcon({
			kind: e.kind,
			label: e.label
		}, { size: "s" }), e.label, h("small", { class: "dim" }, e.needs || "Free"))));
	};
	let request = 0;
	const fetch = () => {
		if (!current()) return;
		const asked = ++request;
		feedback.textContent = "Loading choices";
		void owner.supplyCatalogue().then((rows) => {
			if (!current() || asked !== request) return;
			feedback.textContent = "";
			paint(rows);
		}).catch(() => {
			if (!current() || asked !== request) return;
			feedback.textContent = "Choices unavailable";
			replace(catalogue, h(
				"button",
				{
					class: "btn",
					onclick: fetch
				},
				/* copy:button */
				"Retry"
			));
		});
	};
	const body = h("section", { class: "bloodline-loadouts" }, startingKits(app), h(
		"div",
		{ class: "label row-label" },
		/* copy:label */
		"Prepared kit",
		h("span", { class: "num" }, `${picks.length}/${cap ?? "—"}`)
	), h(
		"p",
		null,
		/* copy:diary_line */
		"Unlocked items are free to prepare and reuse."
	), away ? h(
		"div",
		{
			class: "dim",
			role: "status"
		},
		/* copy:callout */
		"Change at home"
	) : null, h("div", { class: "bloodline-prepared" }, ...picks.map((p) => h("div", {
		class: "game-inset loadout-copy",
		"data-prepared-id": p.id
	}, itemIcon(p, { size: "s" }), itemName(p), h(
		"button",
		{
			class: "chip",
			disabled: away,
			"aria-label": /* copy:button */ "Remove item",
			"data-drop-id": p.id,
			onclick: () => {
				if (current() && !app.lineage.live && app.lineage.town?.home !== false) if (authored && owner.setStartingKit && !p.free && authored.supplies.includes(p.kind)) {
					const supplies = [...authored.supplies];
					supplies.splice(supplies.indexOf(p.kind), 1);
					void app.mutate(
						() => owner.setStartingKit(JSON.stringify({
							...authored,
							supplies
						})),
						/* copy:callout */
						"Kit changed"
					);
				} else void app.dropSupply(p.id);
			}
		},
		/* copy:button */
		"Remove"
	)))), !picks.length ? h(
		"div",
		{ class: "dim" },
		/* copy:label */
		"No preparations"
	) : null, h("button", {
		class: "btn bloodline-reuse",
		"aria-pressed": String(L.repeat !== false),
		disabled: away || !owner.setRestock,
		onclick: () => {
			if (current() && !app.lineage.live && app.lineage.town?.home !== false) void app.mutate(
				() => owner.setRestock(app.lineage.repeat === false),
				/* copy:callout */
				"Reuse changed"
			);
		}
	}, L.repeat !== false ? "Reuse on" : /* copy:button */ "Reuse off"), catalogue, feedback);
	queueMicrotask(fetch);
	return body;
}
